description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timebender, adding {U}.
When Timebender dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Timebender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Timebender's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Timebender triggers, either removing up to two time counters from a card, or putting two time counters onto a suspended card or a permanent with a time counter on it.
Repeat.
